evals.name: single-file-env-wrapper
evals.prompt: bot/pipeline/reinforce/case2/training/env.py を JAX に書き換えて。GPU で回せるようにしたい。
evals.expected_output: Creates env_jax.py beside env.py, ports the OrbitWarsEpisode/reward-shaping logic to fixed-shape masked JAX, and writes a parity pytest that compares ship totals / shaping reward against the Python original within float32 tolerance. Reports green test output and any deferred features.

evals.name: vague-this-target
evals.prompt: rollout.py の中の collect_rollout を jax 化したい。これ、scan と vmap でちゃんと一本のトレースになるようにしてくれる？parity も確認したい。
evals.expected_output: Resolves the target to a rollout file (asks if ambiguous which case), ports the rollout loop to lax.scan + vmap with a single trace (no per-seed recompile), and writes a trajectory-parity test comparing macro state exactly and float positions within a band. References rollout_jax.py conventions.

evals.name: directory-agent-port
evals.prompt: pipeline/rulebase/case2 の rule-based agent 一式を JAX に port して。baseline_jax/ みたいなパッケージにして、元の Python agent と挙動が一致することをテストで担保したい。
evals.expected_output: Ports the agent directory file-by-file in dependency order into a *_jax/ package using fixed shapes + masks and lax primitives, mirrors the existing baseline_jax/ layout, and adds a parity test asserting the JAX agent's chosen actions match the Python agent on shared observations. Lint/types pass.
